policy_title:
Noninvasive Estimate of Coronary Fractional
Flow Reserve (FFR)

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for a non-invasive estimate of coronary fractional flow reserve (FFR) 
derived from augmentative software analysis of the data set from a coronary computed 
tomography angiography when 
• 
Reported with the approved ICD-10-CM diagnosis code to indicate an abnormal finding 
on diagnostic imaging of heart and coronary circulation 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
Procedure is reported without an approved diagnosis. 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT code(s), ICD-10-CM 
code(s) and/or HCPCS Codes reported.
